text:
Jess: morning async — quick standup for the micro launch push. What I did: finalized two headline variants for the benchmark posts, uploaded hero assets to GDrive, and flagged one missing ALT. Blockers: need Priya's final copy approval and a legal check on a competitor screenshot. Today: ship CTA microsite tests by noon and compile launch notes by 4pm. :eyes:
Tom: grabbing the CTA test infra now, will queue a canary at 11:30. Can someone drop the exact hero image link?
Ana: I can finish the ALT copy now, will add to the asset folder and ping when done.
Priya: on legal — I can review the screenshot, aiming for a decision by 10:30. Approving headline set B but please remove any "guarantee" phrasing.
Sam: bench update — re-run scheduled, yesterday's run flaked at step 3. I'll re-run with seed=42 and post results to #marketing-bench.
Tom: @Jess pasted small CSS tweak in the PR for the CTA alignment. Also need the image link to point to the optimized webp.
Jess: image link: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/xyz-hero.png — alt text: "team around laptop". Pushed copy tweaks to PR #891.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary test by Tom at 11:30 UTC. Status: pending.
Priya: legal OK if we blur the competitor name and keep the screenshot context. Jess, can you update the mock? :white_check_mark:
Ana: updated hero with blurred overlay and new alt, pushed as hero_v2.webp to the assets folder.
Tom: canary deployed, seeing ~120ms p95 on the bench env which matches baseline. Noticed a 2% token cost blip during tokenization step — will monitor, plan rollback if it exceeds 5%.
Jess: great, blocker cleared on legal. I'll monitor the canary and compile the launch notes. If eng is green, we'll proceed to staggered rollout at 15:00. :thumbsup:
Sam: bench re-run finished, posting results now to #marketing-bench and tagging @Jess with a short summary.
Priya: heads up — OOO after 15:00 but reachable for urgent approvals via DM. Good work team, keep pings short in this thread.
Tom: noted. Ping me in #eng-runtime if anything spikes during rollout.
Jess: thanks all — will follow up with a quick summary doc and checklist after the noon CTA tests. :rocket:
